name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Good evening, folks. Final score, South Carolina State 31, Florida A&M 13. Was that the trenches, the quarterback play, or the coaching that opened that gap?

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Well, Renee, when you look at the tape, the signal-callers really struggled. FAMU's Isaiah Knowles only completed 7 of 22 passes.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, sacks and shut downs don’t lie...FAMU’s line folded before Knowles even got a chance. Pressure bred panic, and that’s on the trenches, no cap.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Look, Cassius, I hear you, but even with pressure, Keely Watson for SCSU threw two picks, one for an 80-yard touchdown. That's on the signal-caller.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Cassius, if the line dictated everything, how does Watson still cough up two picks against that same pressure? Explain that gap.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, Watson's picks? That's the fallout from his line getting ghosted all night. You can't throw from a collapsing pocket...FAMU's front four got exposed, and that broke their QB's rhythm.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: I get that, Cassius, but even ClutchPoints.com said SCSU needs to figure out their quarterback situation, and FAMU's coaching staff has 'a lot to reassess.'

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, no shade to the QBs, but the story's the frontline...FAMU's O-line got steamrolled by SCSU's front four, pressure so tight it sealed the trenches' win.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Cassius, you can't overlook those two interceptions from Keely Watson, especially one going 80 yards the other way. That's a huge swing, regardless of the pocket.

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, interceptions hot, but defense controlled the clock and the cadence...set every snap’s tone before QBs even blinked. Trenches wrote the script, made the game one-sided.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: But Cassius, when Keely Watson throws two picks, including that 80-yard house call, that's a momentum killer and a coaching adjustment opportunity missed. You gotta give the QBs credit for that impact.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Here's the thing both of you keep skipping past.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Renee, the box score tells a clear story: Knowles was 7-for-22, and Watson tossed two costly interceptions. That's a quarterback problem.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Andrew, a stat line tells you what happened, not why. Cassius says the pocket caused those numbers, you're saying the numbers stand alone. Which is it?

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, I respect the QB spotlight...but a crumbling front line don't just mess with timing, it breaks the whole offense’s back, and the stat sheet just echoes that pain.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Both sides have a case that survives the follow-up, and neither of you has closed it. We leave this one open tonight, and pick the thread back up next time.
